definition.label: 整批统一释放，连续秒租赁
definition.adaptation: BaTS reservation-time multiplied by fleet-price structure; fixed 50 VMs, all leased at t=0 and released together at the observed batch makespan; continuous-time limit of reservation billing. This fleet policy and continuous-time specialization are our assumptions. No exact source formula or live tariff claim. Normalized cost equals normalized makespan exactly, so this duplicates that criterion.
